name: Arroyo Grande City Hall Farmers' Market
tagline: Arroyo Grande City Hall Farmers' Market
description: Arroyo Grande City Hall Farmers' Market is a farmers market in 214 East Branch Arroyo Grande, CA, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
